description: This file contains unit tests for the chat schema models, specifically testing validation and behavior of the ChatRequest and ChatMessage classes from the src.api.schemas.chat module.

classes.name: ChatRequest
classes.description: A data model representing a chat request message, with validation rules.

classes.name: ChatMessage
classes.description: A data model representing a chat message with role and content fields, with validation rules.

methods.name: test_chat_request_validates_message()
methods.description: Tests that a valid chat request with a message passes validation.

methods.name: test_chat_request_rejects_empty_message()
methods.description: Tests that a chat request with an empty or whitespace-only message raises a ValidationError.

methods.name: test_chat_message_role_and_content()
methods.description: Tests that a chat message with proper role and content fields is correctly instantiated.

methods.name: test_chat_message_requires_content()
methods.description: Tests that a chat message with empty content raises a ValidationError.
